usedFor: Personio holds your employee records, and Google Contacts gets a new contact from “Person Created” through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Person Created” in Personio, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: New hires appear in the shared address book without anyone copying their details over.

watchOut: Pairing “Person Updated” with “Create Contact” adds a new contact on each edit, not an update.
